source_message:
feat(security): G-14 OPA Sidecar Pilot — runtime pre-decision enforcement, 28 tests

- opa_sidecar.py: OPASidecar wraps rego_evaluator.evaluate() as runtime layer
  before agent decisions; enforces 3 critical rules:
  RULE-01 (I-22) Level-2/3 no policy layer write → DENY
  RULE-02 (I-23) emergency stop must be checked → DENY
  RULE-03 (I-25) ExplanationBundle required >£10K → ESCALATE(MLRO)
- PolicyDecision frozen dataclass: allowed, outcome(ALLOW/DENY/ESCALATE),
  rule_id, reason, escalation_target, violations
- Fail-closed: any internal exception → DENY with rule_id=SIDECAR_ERROR
- All evaluations logged via StructuredLogger.event() (I-24 audit trail)
- get_sidecar() module-level singleton
- Integration point: call before banxe_aml_orchestrator._layer2_assess()

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
